episodes.synopsis: Tamamo Cross swears that her takoyaki will be the best food stand at the Solefall Faire. She juuust so happens to be next to Gold Ship's yakisoba stand. But hey, what could possibly go wrong with Golshi around?
episodes.title: Brutal Standoff

episodes.synopsis: When several people inexplicably vanish from the remote Yatsuhashi Village,  Detective Seiun Sky and Officer King Halo rush to the scene.  Will they be able to unravel the truth behind the mysterious "blight?"
episodes.title: Yatsuhashi Blight—the Seiun Case Files

episodes.synopsis: Biwa Hayahide gathers Hishi Miracle and fellow racers for a test run before the Spring Fan Fest.  She's got some crazy plans, so it's bound to be a relay unlike any before!
episodes.title: Destiny's Tide—the Turbulent Relay

episodes.synopsis: Curren Chan's planning a social media feature on the joys of spectating,  so racing buff Chrono Genesis agrees to take her and friends on a #kawaii day at the track!
episodes.title: The Art of Spectating
